senses.gloss: दोल m. 1. Swinging, recking; 2. a swing, a litter; 3. a festival held on the full moon day of the month of Phālguna when figures of Kṛṣṇa are swung in swings.
दोला f. 1. A litter, a hammock; 2. a swing, e.g. अनुभवन्नवदोलमृतूत्सवम् R.ix.46, xix.43; 3. swinging, fluctuation.
दोला f. 1. A litter, a hammock; 2. a swing, e.g. अनुभवन्नवदोलमृतूत्सवम् R.ix.46, xix.43; 3. swinging, fluctuation.
दोला-अधिरूढ a. 1. mounted on a swing (lit.); 2. restless, disquieted, uncertain, irresolute (fig.).

दोला-युद्ध n. a fight with varying success.
